fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase Q3 results for the first time since 2023 missed expectations, but raised 2026 net income guidance to $106.2B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Company shifting direction to reduce share buybacks and focus on dividend expansion, technology, and AI investments, prioritizing long-term structural improvement over short-term profitability.
fields.summary_ko.2: Reaching 2029 consensus target EPS of $68.8B (current $63.6B) requires monetizing technology investments, with credit and market deterioration posing margin pressure risks.
